description: Explains why a webhook's signature verified or failed: detected provider scheme (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Slack, Standard Webhooks, Twilio), wrong secret, stale timestamp, or a body that was modified (reformatted JSON, re-escaped slashes). Checks against the secret saved on the endpoint, or against `secret` to try a candidate without saving it.

event_id.description: Which event: its number (12 or "#12", from list_events or the dashboard), "latest", "latest <event type>" such as "latest invoice.paid", or the provider's own event id such as evt_1Qx...

secret.description: Optional candidate signing secret to test instead of the saved one (not stored)

name: debug_signature
title: Debug signature
